from dataclasses import dataclass


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PublicRoute:
    pattern: str
    # When False, each pattern segment must match exactly one path segment,
    # so a star cannot reach into nested folders (MEDIA-284).
    span_segments: bool = True


DEFAULT_ROUTES = (PublicRoute("/teams/*/badge.png", span_segments=False),)
EOF

def test_badge_route_does_not_reach_nested_folders():
    service = AssetService({
        "/teams/west/badge.png": b"PNG",
        "/teams/west/drafts/badge.png": b"draft",
    })
    assert service.fetch("/teams/west/badge.png") == (200, b"PNG")
